summary: Completed comprehensive testing of admin login bug fix. Backend and frontend admin authentication working correctly with httpOnly cookie-based sessions.

minor_issues.issue: Login with email field (instead of username) returns 401. Backend accepts email in request body but compares it against ADMIN_USERNAME instead of ADMIN_EMAIL.
minor_issues.impact: Low - Frontend correctly uses username field, not email field
minor_issues.note: Not part of the reported bug. Current implementation works as designed.

infrastructure_fixes.fix: Started MariaDB service and created homeland database with proper user privileges

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/ - Identity endpoint returns correct service info
Backend: GET /api/health - Health check returns 200 with MySQL connected
Backend: GET /api/projects - Returns 10 projects with correct hero_image format
Backend: POST /api/admin/login with correct username - Returns 200 + httpOnly cookie + all required fields
Backend: POST /api/admin/login with wrong password - Returns 401 with error message
Backend: POST /api/admin/login with wrong username - Returns 401 with error message
Backend: GET /api/admin/me with valid cookie - Returns 200 with admin identity
Backend: GET /api/admin/me without cookie - Returns 401 (not authenticated)
Backend: GET /api/admin/leads with valid cookie - Returns 200 with leads array
Backend: GET /api/admin/leads without cookie - Returns 401 (not authenticated)
Frontend: Admin login page loads correctly with all form elements
Frontend: Login with correct credentials (admin/Homeland@2013) successfully navigates to admin dashboard
Frontend: Admin dashboard displays correctly with sidebar navigation and stats
Frontend: Session persists after page reload (cookie-based authentication)
Frontend: Login with wrong credentials shows error toast and stays on login page
Frontend: Error message 'Invalid username or password' displays correctly
